worker_notes: Only assigned replication n and effect-size fields were targeted. Original and reported-success entries are unassigned placeholders. Printed dz is retained without conversion to unspecified d. Same-test p is retained with its printed bound. The source gives 62 contributors (31 per encoding group) and two participant exclusions from all LDT analyses, but no explicit final participant N for the pooled speed contrasts or final encoding-group counts. The mixed ANOVA prints F(1, 58) / F(2, 116), whereas the paired contrasts print t(58). These do not consistently establish one analytic N. Recruitment is not substituted for analytic N and N is not inferred from df. Candidate only: 62 recruitment participants - 2 explicitly described LDT exclusions = 60; not entered as analytic N. No mutually exclusive final analytic-group counts are printed. Paired t(58) is retained as printed, not used to derive N. Trial removal (7.14%) is a different counting role.
